interpretations: Count each matched `manager_award` row as one win; group by `player.throws`, including NULL; select hands whose share exceeds the mean share across all hands; return the sum of their wins, their mean share, and their mean percentage-point excess over that overall mean.

Count distinct matched managers as winners; group by `player.throws`, including NULL; select hands whose share of distinct managers exceeds the mean share across all hands; return their combined manager count, mean share, and mean percentage-point excess.
Count distinct matched manager–award combinations as wins, so repeated records for the same manager and award count once; group and calculate the three results as above.
Count distinct matched manager–award–year combinations as wins, so a manager can win the same award in different years; group and calculate the three results as above.
For any of those tally units, express “how far above the average share” as the mean relative excess over the overall mean share, rather than a percentage-point difference.
Count each distinct matched manager–year combination once; group by throwing hand, including missing, and calculate the three results as described.
Count each distinct matched manager–award–year–league combination once; group by throwing hand, including missing, and calculate the three results as described.
For any tally unit, treat both NULL and blank `throws` values as the same missing group.
queries:
WITH hand_wins AS (
    SELECT p.throws AS hand, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    LEFT JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
),
hand_shares AS (
    SELECT hand, wins, 1.0 * wins / SUM(wins) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_wins
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share
    FROM hand_shares
)
SELECT SUM(h.wins) AS wins,
       AVG(h.share) AS mean_share,
       AVG((h.share - o.mean_share) * 100) AS mean_percentage_point_excess
FROM hand_shares AS h
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE h.share > o.mean_share

WITH winners_by_hand AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS manager_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        throws,
        manager_count,
        1.0 * manager_count / SUM(manager_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM winners_by_hand
),
compared AS (
    SELECT
        manager_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS mean_share_all_hands
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(manager_count) AS combined_manager_count,
    AVG(share) AS mean_share,
    AVG((share - mean_share_all_hands) * 100) AS mean_percentage_point_excess
FROM compared
WHERE share > mean_share_all_hands

SELECT throws, COUNT(*) AS manager_year_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.player_id, m.year, p.throws
    FROM manager AS m
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = m.player_id
)
GROUP BY throws
